name: Question 2
problem: A particular traditional festival is usually held on a single day after the $15$th and before the $26$th of August. The exact day is selected each year and depends on the weather conditions. Each day after the $15$th and before the $26$th of August has an equal probability of being chosen. What is the probability that the festival will take place before the $18$th of August next year?
